payload.title: Integrate run history and navigation with accessible slide-out drawers
payload.description: Provide a left slide-out history drawer for optimization runs/interactive sessions and edition history, scoped to selected scorecard with search/filter and active/inspected distinction. Keep it closed during focused labeling by default; do not permanently consume labeling width. Provide app-level navigation accessible at narrow sizes, deep links and browser back/forward preserving selected scorecard/run/view. Drawer opening is local UI state, not a run mutation; retain current item, pending job and unsaved comments/labels on close or navigation cancellation. Focus management, Escape, backdrop dismissal, accessible names and touch targets. Acceptance: open history, inspect another run, return to active session with drafts intact; tablet overlay never obscures unreachable dismiss/actions; inactive editions clearly read-only until explicitly activated.
